verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms the existence of official KDE Spins alongside the GNOME-based Workstation default (e.g., 'Fedora 40 KDE Spin', 'Fedora 39 KDE Spin'), showing power-users can choose among desktop environments, but the evidence pack lacks official docs enumerating all variants or their distinct default settings, and includes mixed reports on quality/stability of non-default spins.
